description:
After being abandoned by his last remaining family, Yeonho is left with nothing but his father’s enormous debt and directions to the largest mansion in the city. With nowhere to turn and no means to survive on his own, Yeonho enters the mansion as the newest servant. The work is hard and staying in the good graces of the other servants is even harder, but as the lowest rung on the ladder, Yeonho expected as much. What he didn’t expect, however, was for both the master and the young master of the house to take a…special interest in him. Yeonho has only ever wanted to repay his debt and escape the mansion as quickly as possible, but could something else prompt him to stay? 

(Source: Lezhin US) *Note: Chapter count includes a preview*
